options.name: auth
options.description: Parameters for authenticating with the AWS service. Each of them may be defined via environment variables.

options.name: clear_tags
options.description: Whether to clear any existing tags on the resource that are not explicitly stated in I(tags). By default, existing tags are kept on the resource. When this parameter is set to C(true), any pre-existing tags on the resource (including the name tag) are removed. To clear all tags except the name tag, make sure to provide the I(name) parameter.

options.name: description
options.description: Short description of the AWS resource.

options.name: egress
options.description: Egress (outbound) security rules. Note that by default, every newly created security group will include a default egress rule which permits all outbound traffic.

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the resource to perform the task on. If specified, this parameter is used to identify the resource. Omit this parameter when you are first creating the resource.

options.name: ingress
options.description: Ingress (inbound) security rules. Note that AWS creates a default ingress rule, which allows all traffic from the same security group, but only in the default security group created when a VPC is created.

options.name: name
options.description: The name for the security group. Required when creating a security group or in combination with I(vpc) to uniquely identify one. Note that the security group name is not an AWS resource tag.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the security group. If C(absent), the security group is first detached from any instances and then deleted.

options.name: tags
options.description: Metadata for the AWS resource as key/value pairs. Keys and values are case-sensitive.

options.name: vpc
options.description: The ID of the VPC to assign this security group to. If omitted, the default VPC is assumed. When I(id) is not specified, I(vpc) will be used to identify a single security group in combination with I(name).
